title: Operation Contract v0.1
description: The per-operation contract consumed by the Operations Runtime (ADR-013). Every unique (operationId, majorVersion) pair has exactly one Operation Contract published in the metadata registry. A CAM OperationModel entry names the contract; the kernel resolves the contract at load time and hands it to the Operations Runtime along with a matching adapter binding. The contract is technology-agnostic: it declares what an operation does — inputs, outputs, guards, idempotency, retry, error taxonomy, side effect kinds, audit — but not how any specific adapter fulfils it. See ADR-014 for the adapter side of the contract.

operationContractVersion.description: Version of the Operation Contract envelope itself. Currently '0.1'.

version.description: Operation major version. Matches the ':vN' suffix used in CAM operationRef and in the state machine transition.triggeredBy field.

windowSeconds.description: How long the Operations Runtime deduplicates identical requests. Absent means the platform default.

guardRef.description: Optional single rule that must evaluate true before the operation is dispatched. Combined-expression guards live at the transition level, not the operation.

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema for the operation's input payload. Validated by the Operations Runtime before the adapter is invoked.

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema for the operation's output payload. Validated by the Operations Runtime after the adapter returns and before the effect is emitted.

sideEffects.description: Declared side-effect tags. Must be a superset of any effect kinds the operation may emit. Trivially derivable from CAM WorkflowModel and OperationModel. Used at load-time to verify adapter capabilities cover the operation.

auditEvent.description: Audit event name written to the audit log for every successful invocation. Failed invocations produce '<auditEvent>.failed'.

binding.description: Free-form binding string interpreted by the adapter for this kind. Examples: 'entity.customer', 'object-store:default', 'notification:email'.

requiredCapabilities.description: Adapter capabilities the operation requires. The kernel refuses to load a CAM if the bound adapter does not declare these. See ADR-014.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Stable across versions.

timeoutMs.description: Hard timeout enforced by the Operations Runtime. If absent, the platform default applies.

jsonSchemaFragment.$comment: A JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 fragment. Deliberately typed as 'object' at v0.1 rather than $ref'ing the full meta-schema, to avoid pulling the meta-schema into every validator run. The Operations Runtime compiles fragments with Ajv2020 at load time; malformed fragments are reported as load-time Diagnostics.
